name: Sauerkraut Salad
description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

keywords: sauerkraut salad, tangy salad, make-ahead salad
